name: Turn Infidel
body:
Enemies of your faith will flee before you.

Prerequisite(s): Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful alignment, ability to command or turn undead, divine spellcaster.

Benefit: Select an alignment that opposes one aspect of yours (i. e., if you are Chaotic Good, you can select evil or lawful). You can spend one use of your command or turn undead ability to attempt rebuking one divine spellcaster of the chosen alignment. This follows the same rules to turn intelligent undead.

Special: This feat can be granted as a bonus feat by some deities or in some campaigns heavily based on religion wars.
